div.p: Can't find what you need? Ask an agent

details.summary: Do I pay Propelle anything as a buyer?
details.p: In most sales the seller pays the agents' commission. If you ask us to find a home that isn't listed, we'll agree a buyer's fee with you in writing before we start.

details.summary: How much deposit do I need?
details.p: Lenders usually ask for 10 to 20 percent of the price, and more for jumbo loans or second homes. You'll also need an earnest money deposit, typically 1 to 3 percent, when your offer is accepted.

details.summary: Can I view homes by video?
details.p: Yes. Your agent can walk you through any home on a video call and answer questions as you go. Plenty of our clients buy before visiting in person.
Usually 30 to 45 days after your offer is accepted with a mortgage, or as little as two weeks if you're paying cash.

details.summary: Do you help with buying from overseas?
details.p: We do. We work with lenders and attorneys who handle international buyers, and we can manage most of the process remotely.
